name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Famous Lobster Nachos (Serrano Chili, Chipotle Crema & Corn Chip Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Reference warning: although the warm poached lobster meat itself is lean, the dish is built on sharp fried corn tortilla chips with black beans, aged cheddar-oaxaca cheese sauce, pico de gallo, sliced raw serrano chilies, and chipotle crema.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If your table orders Lobster Nachos to share, pick out a few pieces of plain warm lobster meat from the top and avoid the serrano chilies, black beans, and spicy chipotle crema.
watchOuts: Loaded with raw serrano chilies, black beans, fried corn tortilla edges, dairy queso, and lime (citrusFree: false)
